title: Edgar Mitchell's ESP experiment on Apollo 14
place_text: Apollo 14, en route to the Moon

tellings.quote: On his journey to the moon, Mitchell conducted a private ESP or extrasensory perception experiment, attempting to send mental images back to Earth using a set of cards.

plain: On the way to the Moon on Apollo 14 in 1971, the astronaut Edgar Mitchell is said to have run a private experiment in extrasensory perception, or ESP, the idea of sensing or sending information by mind alone, trying to send mental images of a set of cards back to people on Earth. Michels tells it, pointing to a 1971 New York Times interview with Mitchell as his source.
